title: Deal Signed to Sell Lukoil’s Foreign Assets, but Without Envoys’ Business Associates
summary_full: Valuable properties belonging to the Russian energy giant will be sold to an American-led consortium. But Middle Eastern business contacts of the peace negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are no longer part of the buyer group.
